description: This file defines the TimeoutInvalidException class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to signal invalid timeout values in messages. It includes constructors, builder pattern implementation, JSON deserialization, and deprecated annotations.

classes.name: TimeoutInvalidException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException to represent invalid timeout errors, with static methods for creation and deserialization, and a nested Builder class.

classes.name: TimeoutInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing TimeoutInvalidException instances with a fluent API, supporting customization of message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: TimeoutInvalidException(final Long timeout, final Long maxTimeout)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a formatted message indicating the invalid timeout and maximum allowed timeout.

methods.name: fromMessage(final String message)
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a specified message string.

methods.name: fromJson(final JsonObject jsonObject, final DittoHeaders dittoHeaders)
methods.description: Static method to deserialize the exception from a JSON representation.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders(final DittoHeaders dittoHeaders)
methods.description: Overrides method to set new headers in an existing exception instance.
